versions.name: Drafting
versions.description: Format a drawing sheet with a title block, produce an architectural, mechanical, or electrical drawing by hand in pencil, redraw it in CAD, then mark up revisions and letter your own conclusions in Gothic script.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
